desc: Read input $N, M, K$ and the list of edges.
Implement BFS to find the shortest path length $L$ in the unweighted graph.
Implement Max Flow (Dinic's algorithm) to find the maximum number of edge-disjoint paths $P$.
Calculate the answer as $\min(L, \lfloor K / P \rfloor)$.
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
If samples pass, mark as done. If not, debug.
